Form.needNpc: Please choose an NPC or enter a name.

Export.done: History of {npc} ({trackers} trackers) written to the field “{field}”.
Export.noField: No Campaign Builder field is chosen for the history. Choose one in the module settings (“{setting}”).
Export.fieldMissing: The Campaign Builder field “{field}” chosen for the history no longer exists or is no editor field. Choose another one in the module settings (“{setting}”).
Export.manualNpc: This NPC is only a name, not a Campaign Builder entry, so there is no field to write to.
Export.npcMissing: The NPC's Campaign Builder entry no longer exists.
Export.footer: Transferred from the NPC trackers on {date}. This field is overwritten on every transfer.

logTime.name: Time in the change log
logTime.hint: Which time log entries show. In-world time comes from the world calendar (game time); entries made before this option existed only have the real time.

exportField.name: Field for the history
exportField.hint: Campaign Builder character field (editor type only) that receives the tracker history of an NPC. Every transfer overwrites the whole field, so use a field of its own.

exportFieldOrganization.name: Field for the history (organizations)
exportFieldOrganization.hint: Campaign Builder organization field (editor type only) that receives the tracker history of an organization. Every transfer overwrites the whole field, so use a field of its own.

exportOrder.name: Order of the transferred history
exportOrder.hint: Order of the changes written into the Campaign Builder field.
